name: Swamp Smartweed
desc: Swamp Smartweed (Persicaria hydropiperoides): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 1 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Persicaria hydropiperoides, commonly called swamp smartweed, mild waterpepper, false waterpepper, or sometimes simply waterpepper, is a species of flowering plant in the buckwheat family.
